title: Skeleton Dance in Mirror
description: A giant stone hand holds an ornate oval mirror framed with glowing purple crystals and turquoise energy. Inside the cracked mirror, two female skeletons in pink and purple dresses hold hands, one with flowing red hair. Below, a woman in a dark dress stands at the center of a circular formation of hooded figures on cracked stone ground.
prompt: A giant stone hand emerging from the ground holds a large ornate oval mirror framed with glowing purple crystals and dripping turquoise magical energy. Inside the cracked mirror, two female skeletons wearing elegant pink and purple dresses dance while holding hands, one with long flowing red hair. In the foreground, a woman in a dark flowing dress stands at the center of a large circular formation of hooded figures arranged on cracked stone ground beneath a swirling orange and teal sky, dramatic beams of light, dark fantasy atmosphere.
